verdict.rationale: The evidence shows no AI assistant built into Cake itself. The AI capability documented is an MCP server that lets external clients (Claude, Codex, Cursor) run read-only queries against the cap table. That is a different story: an external-agent integration, not a built-in assistant you can delegate tasks to. A cap table SaaS could plausibly ship an embedded assistant, so the axis applies, but nothing in the pack evidences one.
